summary: Converts POP geometry into SOP geometry, bridging the new POP GPU workflow back into SOP-based tools and render pipelines.
key_concepts: POP geometry to SOP geometry bridge
SOP compatibility for downstream legacy tools
Info CHOP num_points, num_prims, and num_particles diagnostics
common_gotchas: POP to SOP downloads POP data into SOP form, so dense GPU point clouds can become expensive.
Use this bridge when SOP compatibility is needed; keep processing in POPs when possible for GPU-side workflows.
Attribute support depends on what the POP source contains and what the SOP conversion can represent.
